description: Erection of a single storey side infill extension, installation of an additional rear roof window and replacing a side door to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [541/000, 541/009, 541/010, 541/011, 541/012, 541/013, 541/014, 541/015, 541/016, 541/017, 541/018, 541/019, 541/100, 541/101, 541/102, 541/103, 541/104, 541/105, 541/106, 541/107, 541/108, 541/109, 541/110, 541/111, 541/112, Design/Access & Planning Statement, Flood Risk Assessment and Planning Fire Strategy. Received: 2/4/2024; 541/111 Rev A. Received: 9/5/2024].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - The window to be fitted on the rear roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
